description: This file contains unit tests for the hex string serialization and deserialization functions in the Thunder project, specifically testing the ToHexString and FromHexString functions within the Thunder::Core namespace.

methods.name: serialiation_working
methods.description: Test that serializing a byte array to a hex string produces the expected lowercase output.

methods.name: deserialization_lowercase
methods.description: Test that deserializing a lowercase hex string correctly converts to the original byte array.

methods.name: deserialization_uppercase
methods.description: Test that deserializing an uppercase hex string correctly converts to the original byte array.

methods.name: deserialization_uneven
methods.description: Test that deserializing a hex string with an uneven length correctly converts to the expected byte array.

methods.name: no_buffer_overflow
methods.description: Test that deserialization does not overflow the buffer and correctly processes a hex string with more data than the buffer size.
